target.statement: Output space ensemble of two models trained on MultiColorMNIST achieves higher OOD accuracy than individual models (e.g., at p=0.90, ensemble 29.28% vs model1 26.01% and model2 26.63%)

compute.basis: Training two small CNNs on a 10-class MNIST variant with 32 color patches for 5 p-values, each with multiple seeds, is feasible on CPU but requires implementing the dataset and training pipeline from scratch since no code is released.

blockers: Requires reimplementation of data generation and training protocol
title: Spurious Feature Diversification Improves Out-of-distribution Generalization
